desc: **Task 0 — Ideation:** derive the `a`/`b`/`c` decomposition, the per-`b`-occurrence reduction, and enumerate edge cases.
**Task 1 — First full implementation:** KMP occurrence finder + parsing/degenerate cases + bisect-based combination loop; verified on examples 1–4.

**Task 2 — Edge-case verification:** checked `s="aaaa",p="a*a*a"`→3; `s="a",p="**"`→0; `s="abc",p="*b*"`→1; `s="abc",p="**c"`→1; `s="ab",p="b*a*"`→-1; `s="aaa",p="aa*aa*"`→-1; `s="ab",p="*a*b"`→2; `p="abc**"` / `*abc*` / `**abc` shapes all handled by the empty-chunk special cases.

**Task 3 — Correctness argument:** every match contains a `b`-occurrence at some `j`; for fixed `j` the objective `(k+|c|)-l` separates into an independent predecessor query on `A` (`l ≤ j-|a|`) and successor query on `C` (`k ≥ j+|b|`), each candidate is realizable, so the min over `j` is exact.

**Task 4 — Performance pass:** O(n+m) KMP plus O(n log n) sweep with `bisect`; worst case ~10^5 iterations × 2 binary searches, well within limits; overlapping occurrences preserved via `fail[m-1]` fallback.
